Designed for showroom service — greeting customers, explaining vehicle features and performing live demonstrations — with plans for 2-3 units per BYD dealership worldwide.

Full-size interactive humanoid robot (160 cm, 27 DoF) designed for commercial performance scenarios such as shopping malls, tourist attractions, trade shows and entertainment venues. Powered by LimX's second-generation Sys 0 engine with upgraded joint motors and thermal management; offers multi-modal interaction, millisecond-precise swarm control of 200+ units and an AI task editor for natural-language scene creation.

The third prototype in VinRobotics' high-end humanoid robot series (VR-H3). Stands 178 cm tall and weighs 85 kg with 12-DoF lower body. Uses proprietary high-torque-density actuators with EtherCAT communication, low backlash and near-QDD characteristics. RL-based locomotion achieves 1.5 m/s dynamic walking and 1.8 m/s with human motion data training. VinRobotics pioneers Vietnam's first industrial humanoid robots.

The flagship model (VR-H5) in VinRobotics' humanoid robot series for advanced industrial applications. Part of the VinRobotics Humanoid Platform with open-source SDKs, APIs, ROS 2, MuJoCo, Isaac Lab and LeRobot support. Built on proprietary mechanical structures, intelligent control systems and in-house actuators for Vietnam's industrial humanoid lineup.

The third prototype (VR-M3) in VinRobotics' mid-range humanoid robot line for industrial and service applications. ~60 kg with 12-DoF lower body and 5 kg payload. World's first heavy humanoid to climb unfamiliar staircases using single-camera first-person terrain perception (no LiDAR, no motion capture, no teleoperation). RL-trained locomotion with zero-shot sim2real transfer achieves 0.6 m/s on stairs. URDF model and open-source repos released.

The second prototype in VinRobotics' high-end humanoid robot series, a predecessor to the H3 and H5 in the development of Vietnam's first industrial humanoid robots with proprietary mechanical structures and intelligent control systems.

Successor of HUBO 2; the lineage continues in Rainbow Robotics platforms.

Humanoid robot introduced by Genisom AI / Zhishen Technology at WAIC 2026 as a new embodied-intelligence platform alongside the company's quadruped line.
Industrial wheeled humanoid shown by MagicLab at WAIC 2026 as part of its new product lineup with MagicBot X1 and MagicDog T1.

Hyperrealistic celebrity android from EX Robots' bionic humanoid line; Chinese science and technology coverage notes that Steve Jobs and Albert Einstein versions were demonstrated at the 2021 World Robot Conference and used for museum-style interaction.

DOBOT's LUMO, unveiled August 2026, is billed as the world's first 'embodied all-terrain' humanoid. Standing nearly 1.3 m tall, it walks across lawn, sand and cobblestone with an anthropomorphic gait, boxes, dances and performs backflips. Powered by DOBOT's self-developed Kongyi embodied large model, it fuses vision, voice and motion for multimodal emotion perception, 3D spatial understanding and autonomous learning that adapts over time. Designed as a home companion, sports playmate and popular-science partner for everyday users, and as a secondary-development platform for K12, vocational and research users.

Embodied intelligence home companion robot with 20 DoF, dual arms, bipedal and wheeled mobility modes. LDS LiDAR whole-home mapping, iTOF depth sensing, vision camera, IMU and 3-mic array with 16-foot pickup. Fall detection, safety checks, daily assistance, scam prevention, pet monitoring and remote interaction. Open multi-language programming platform with VR integration and reinforcement learning tools. Fast charging 80% in 1 hour.

Compact full-size humanoid robot for versatile real-world applications. Supports both teleoperation and autonomous modes, adapting to different task requirements. Designed for training, simulation and front-of-house service with intelligent interaction and operational capabilities for real-world human environments.

World's first mass-produced transformable mecha. Manned bipedal-to-quadruped machine with a torso-mounted cockpit for a pilot. Transitions between bipedal walking and four-legged crawl mode. 500 kg total weight with pilot, high-strength alloy construction. Starting price 3.9 million yuan.
Low-cost modular humanoid starting at $4,290 with 31 degrees of freedom and flexible deployment. Quietly launched alongside Unitree's Shanghai IPO pricing in August 2026.

Full-stack Physical AI company spun out of Toyota Research Institute in January 2026. Builds general-purpose robots powered by Large Behavior Models (LBMs) and Diffusion Policy. Deployed in production at a Toyota plant since February 2026 doing machine tending, tool setting, parts kitting and assembly. $300M seed at $1.1B valuation co-led by Toyota and Deviation Capital with NVIDIA, Boeing and Samsung Ventures.

Wheeled industrial humanoid robot from TARS Robotics (它石智航), Shanghai. 170 cm tall with 36 DoF and DexHand 21-DoF dexterous hands. AWE 3.0 embodied AI foundation model with SenseHub multimodal perception (RGB-D, tactile, IMU). Guinness World Record for 100+ sub-millimeter wire harness assemblies per hour. Electric servo actuators with harmonic gears, 5G-A connectivity, Linux/ROS. Founded by ex-Huawei ADS CTO Dr. Chen Yilun. $455M pre-A funding.

67-DoF full-body humanoid from Singapore-based Sharpa (founded by Hesai Technology co-founders). SharpaWave dexterous hands with 22 active DoF and 1000+ tactile pixels per fingertip. <0.02s hand reaction time, ~2mm finger positioning precision. CraftNet VTLA neural model (Vision, Tactile, Language, Action). At CES 2026: autonomous ping-pong rallies, 30+ step windmill assembly, card dealing, photography. 4 consecutive days, 8h/day fully autonomous demos.

Wheeled humanoid service robot from Ant Group (Ant Lingbo Technology). 160 cm tall, 34 DoF, Bailing LLM integration for multimodal perception and interaction. Dual-driven embodied control algorithm with simulation and real-world data. iF Design Award 2026. Demonstrated cooking shrimp, museum tour guiding, pharmacy sorting and medical consultation. 48V DC geared motors with encoders. Unveiled September 2025 at IFA Berlin.

Wheeled humanoid from Lanxin Robotics (Hangzhou). 165 cm tall, 700x610x1650 mm, 6-DOF dual arms with 580 mm rotation diameter. 3D laser SLAM navigation, 0.2-2 m operating height. Bipedal research platform for embodied AI development and industrial logistics trials. Successor to VersaBot VB-1, the world's first pure-vision humanoid at WRC 2024.

Wheeled humanoid from Lanxin Robotics. 170 cm tall with 7-joint dual arms, 5 kg grip per arm, 4-wheel omnidirectional base. 3D laser SLAM navigation. CES 2026 sequel to VersaBot VB-1 with extended runtime and improved manipulation. Research and industrial automation platform.

Open-source full-size bipedal humanoid from Shanghai Humanoid Robot Innovation Center. 185 cm tall, 43 active DoF (14 arms, 12 legs, 16 hands, 1 waist) with 60 total joints. Custom rotary electric actuators with harmonic drives, 400 N·m peak joint torque. 400 TOPS compute, 3D LiDAR + depth + surround cameras. Reference platform for global embodied AI ecosystem. Runs Gewu Zhizhi AI training platform.

Wheeled humanoid prototype from SIASUN Robot & Automation (Shenyang). 150-160 cm tall, 35 DoF, 10 kg payload. Industrial collaboration and logistics research platform. Not yet commercially available — internal R&D and showcase only.

Full-size bipedal humanoid from SIASUN Robot & Automation. 30-35 DoF, 10 kg payload, 5 km/h max speed, 6-8 hours battery. Industrial research and human-robot collaboration platform with stable locomotion. Demonstrated at World Robot Conference 2025.

Full-size bipedal humanoid from Lumos Robotics (Shenzhen). 160 cm tall, 38 DoF, 380 N·m peak torque density, 0.2 s instantaneous response. Record-setting <1 second ground-to-upright launch. Neural motion control, IMU + joint torque + angle perception. Founded 2024, designed for industrial automation, healthcare and search-and-rescue.

Heavy-duty industrial wheeled humanoid from PL Universe (Suzhou). 165-195 cm adjustable height, 42 DoF (14 per hand), 300 kg weight. Modular end-effectors for assembly, inspection, handling and packaging. SDPAA architecture for scene adaptation. Mass-produced and delivered to 3C electronics and automotive manufacturing clients. Founded January 2025.

Full-size electric bipedal humanoid from PHYBOT (Beijing, Tsinghua alumni). 172 cm tall, 32 DoF, 530 N·m peak joint torque, >10 kW peak power. First full-sized electric humanoid to perform a standing backflip. NVIDIA Jetson Orin + Intel Core i7, 3D LiDAR, stereo cameras, IMU. 20 kg per arm payload, 50 kg backpack carry. Cycloidal drives, swappable dual batteries.

Compact bipedal humanoid from PHYBOT (Beijing). 128 cm tall, 28 kg. AI-powered companion platform for mobility research and light-duty task interaction. Multimodal sensing with human-like movement. Unveiled alongside M1 at WRC 2025.
Indian humanoid robot from Perceptyne. 34 DoF bipedal platform for embodied AI research. Designed for the Indian manufacturing and service robotics market.
South Korean bipedal humanoid from LG Electronics. General-purpose platform for commercial service applications. In development stage, targeting hospitality and retail scenarios.
Chinese bipedal humanoid from EIR Technology. Research platform for locomotion and manipulation. Successor to SkyWalker 1 with improved balance and dynamic motion control.

Industrial wheeled humanoid from Estun Automation (Nanjing). In development for smart manufacturing and factory automation tasks. Leverages Estun's industrial robot arm expertise into humanoid form factor.
Full-size AGIBOT humanoid platform also referred to as Expedition A3. The base A3 is distinct from A3 Ultra; published specifications include 173 cm height, 55 kg weight and 10-hour endurance.
Wheeled bimanual humanoid from X Square Robot with a 6-DoF mobile base, dual 7-DoF arms and 20-DoF ArtiXon hands.

description: High-speed bipedal humanoid developed by HONOR and nicknamed Lightning. The competition platform supports autonomous navigation, dynamic running and long-distance operation; its liquid-cooled leg joints were reported at more than 4 L/min flow and peak motor torque at 400 N m. It completed the 2026 Beijing E-Town humanoid half-marathon in 50:26 and competed at the World Humanoid Robot Games 2026.

Compact humanoid from HONOR's embodied-AI program, presented alongside Lightning. Yuanqizai is intended for smart-retail interaction and customer guidance in HONOR stores; published reports identify it as a separate platform rather than a Lightning alias.

Wheel-arm humanoid developed by the Fujian Humanoid Robot Innovation Center and prepared for the household-service scenario at the 2026 World Humanoid Robot Games. The platform uses 3D-printed lightweight components, an in-house embodied-intelligence model and multi-robot coordination; field tests were conducted in a Fuzhou metro station.

Five-finger tactile dexterous hand with 20 DoF (16 active + 4 passive), 94 pressure sensors, USB 2.0 and independently replaceable fingers. Unitree's official load conditions list up to 3.5 kg palm-down and 4.5 kg palm-left.

Full-size humanoid service robot designed for urban symbiosis, intelligent service and human-robot interaction across multiple public-facing scenarios. UBTECH positions Walker C1 as a mobile commercial service platform with a multimodal intelligence engine and dynamic motion capabilities.

First full-size humanoid prototype from Darmstadt-based Pink Robotics, designed for logistics sorting. The German-built P0 is 1.75 m tall, weighs 82 kg, has 32 DoF and an 8 kg payload capacity; current demonstrations are teleoperated while VLA manipulation models are being developed.

Compact bipedal developer robot with two-finger grippers and OpenBridge support. Launched September 2, 2026; the manufacturer reports first-batch Geek Edition purchase availability and global booking. Regional pricing and delivery terms vary.

Humanoid interaction and entertainment platform, also called Galaxy Xingzai. Galbot announced reservations on September 3, 2026. Standard configuration has 26 DoF; Pro and Flagship add dexterous hands. Delivery timing is not confirmed.
Wheeled humanoid research platform shown at IFA 2026 for tidying and transporting household objects. Research-stage demonstration; price and commercial release are unannounced.
